fixture-blocked.com.au.remediationSnippet:
Cloudflare refused our site checker on <brand domain>. If it refuses AI search crawlers the same
way, allow them: Cloudflare dashboard -> Security -> WAF -> Custom rules -> Create rule.
Field: User-Agent  |  Operator: contains  |  Value: (GPTBot|ChatGPT-User|OAI-SearchBot|ClaudeBot|Claude-User|Claude-SearchBot|PerplexityBot|Perplexity-User|CCBot)
Action: Allow (Skip remaining custom rules).
Also: Security -> Bots -> set "AI Scrapers and Crawlers" to Allow (if present on your plan).
